Reference image is ONLY the exact earbud product design. Replace the previous elaborate art scene with this simpler scene:

A tiny pair of the referenced graphite-and-champagne CYMBA wired earbuds resting naturally in a clear patch of desk near the lower right, with thin black cables loosely trailing out of frame. Each earbud body is about 2cm across relative to the 21cm width of an A4 sheet. Preserve reference product details: round dark faceplates with narrow champagne rim, smoky compact inner body, small black fins, grey silicone tips, black cables.
Photographic quality: believable everyday photo of someone's painting practice left on their desk. Soft neutral daylight, honest material textures, slightly imperfect casual composition, no glossy advertising finish. Colour comes from the small simple pictures on white paper. Frame close enough that the sheets dominate, but include desk around them.
No canvas, no easel, no elaborate coastal painting, no impasto, no studio styling, no elaborate props, no plant, no people or hands, no writing or logos, no CGI, no dramatic golden sunlight. The entire scene is a realistic photograph; only the pictures ON the paper are watercolour.
